svg.title: Point, side load: SF 1.860
svg.desc: Point, side load. 10 N normal to the blade on the last 0.75 mm, read from 1 to 2.5 mm. Solid SF 1.860, required 1.2.
svg.text: 10 N normal to the blade on the last 0.75 mm, read from 1 to 2.5 mm
Reproduces the record's SF bit for bit (Tier 2 at h 0.2, same platform).
Colour scale tops at the read-out peak (1.0-2.5 mm from the point); stresses at the loaded patch run above it.
TET10 solid, 76440 tets, 361665 DOF · first 6.5 mm of the point, tilted 50° about the bisector · deformation ×2
